data.one_liner: Server-driven UI SDK for rendering designs from the Codelessly Editor natively in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to design screens in the Codelessly Editor and render them natively in a Flutter app with live updates, variables, data, actions, navigation, and paywalls. Published layouts can be loaded via an HTTP slug, Firebase project token, or a bundled offline asset.
use_when: You want to update UI designs, variables, and flows without releasing a new app version.
You want to design screens in an external visual editor and render them natively in Flutter.
avoid_when: You rely completely on traditional code-only widget trees and source control for UI design.
You require Linux desktop support when using Firebase project token live updates.
strengths: Live updates for UI layouts without requiring app store releases.
Multiple loading methods including slugs, Firebase project tokens, and offline bundles.
Supports custom functions, navigation hooks, data binding, scripting, and native paywall placements.
weaknesses: Tied to the proprietary Codelessly platform and editor ecosystem.
Firebase-backed live updates are not supported on Linux desktop.
data.setup_notes: Requires Dart 3.12 and Flutter 3.35 or newer. For Firebase-backed live updates, pass a project token; for scripting, add the codelessly_quickjs package.
data.minimal_example:
final codelessly = Codelessly(config: const CodelesslyConfig(slug: 'my-project'));

runApp(MaterialApp(home: CodelesslyWidget(codelessly: codelessly)));
